name: companion-module-novastar-vx-pro
description: Bitfocus Companion module for Novastar VX Pro series (VX400/600/1000/2000 Pro) — controls the device via its Unico HTTP API.
author: deford <deford@gmail.com>

scripts.pack: node build.mjs && node -e "import('fs').then(fs=>{const{mkdirSync,rmSync,cpSync}=fs;rmSync('tmp',{recursive:true,force:true});mkdirSync('tmp/novastar-vx-pro',{recursive:true});cpSync('pkg/main.js','tmp/novastar-vx-pro/main.js');cpSync('pkg/companion','tmp/novastar-vx-pro/companion',{recursive:true});cpSync('pkg/package.json','tmp/novastar-vx-pro/package.json');import('child_process').then(cp=>cp.execSync('tar czf novastar-vx-pro.tgz -C tmp novastar-vx-pro',{stdio:'inherit'}))})"
